title: Vaishnavism Saints Ramananda
definition: Ramananda was a 14th-15th century Vaishnava devotional poet-saint who bridged the gap between South Indian Bhakti (Ramanuja's Vishishtadvaita) and North Indian vernacular devotionalism, emphasizing Rama-bhakti and social inclusivity.
importanceInUpsc: Ramananda is a pivotal figure in the 'Bhakti Movement' syllabus. UPSC frequently tests his role in democratizing religion, his lineage of disciples, and his departure from rigid caste-based Sanskrit orthodoxy.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Vaishnavism Saints Ramananda.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
